  • Reference

    Contaminant concentrations in benthic macrofauna

    benthos_contam.Rd

    Benthic macrofauna samples collected during the CHOPIN project in the Seine estuary. The dataset contains sampling information, taxonomic and trophic traits, lipid and dry-mass contents, stable isotope measurements, and concentrations of PCBs, PFASs, and HBCDD isomers.

    Format

    A tibble with 50 rows and 148 variables. Each row represents one benthic sample or pooled benthic sample. Variables include:

    year

    Numeric. Sampling year.

    season

    Factor. Sampling season, with levels "Spring" and "Autumn".

    date

    Character. Sampling date as recorded in the original dataset. Values originate from spreadsheet date codes.

    zone

    Factor. Sampling area within the Seine estuary, with levels "Chenal", "Embouchure", "Fosse Nord", and "Fosse Sud".

    site

    Character. Sampling-site identifier. Some samples combine material collected from several sites.

    species

    Character. Taxonomic name of the benthic species, using underscores between genus and species names.

    comment

    Character. Additional information recorded for the sample, including information on specimen size or the material included in the sample.

    sample_TAG

    Character. Sample identifier used in the CHOPIN project.

    mass_dry_percent

    Numeric. Dry mass expressed as a percentage of wet mass.

    lip_dw_percent

    Numeric. Lipid content expressed as a percentage of dry weight.

    delta13C

    Numeric. Carbon stable isotope composition, expressed as delta 13C/12C ‰ values.

    delta15N

    Numeric. Nitrogen stable isotope composition, expressed as delta 15N/14N ‰ values.

    _ng_gdw

    Numeric. Concentration of an individual PCB congener, PFAS compound, or HBCDD isomer, expressed in ng per g dry weight (ng g^-1 dw).

    a.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored, b.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored, g.HBCDD_ng_gdw_censored

    Numeric. HBCDD concentrations prepared for analyses involving censored observations. Values below the analytical quantification threshold are encoded according to the censoring procedure used in the analysis (0 replacement.

    labels

    Character. Abbreviated species labels used in figures and tables.

    taxa

    Character. Broad taxonomic group of each benthic organism: "Bivalves", "Polychaetes", or "Crustaceans".

    alimentation

    Character. Feeding mode of the benthic organism. Codes include "Susp." for suspension feeder, "Dep.sur." for surface deposit feeder, "Dep.sub." for subsurface deposit feeder, "Susp.Dep.sur." for suspension and surface deposit feeder, and "Omnivore" for omnivore.

    mobility

    Character. Functional mobility category of the benthic organism: "sedentary" for largely sessile or highly site-attached taxa, "low mobility" for species capable of limited local movement or repositioning within or on the sediment, and "mobile" for actively moving taxa.

    _ng_glw

    Numeric. Lipid-normalized concentration of an individual PCB congener or HBCDD isomer, expressed in ng per g lipid weight (ng g^-1 lw).

    sumPCB_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of PCB congener concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumPFAS_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of PFAS concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumPFCA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of perfluoroalkyl carboxylic acid (PFCA) concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumFOSA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of FOSA-related compound concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumPFSA_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of perfluoroalkyl sulfonate (PFSA) concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    sumHBCDD_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Sum of alpha-, beta-, and gamma-HBCDD concentrations, expressed in ng per g dry weight.

    _normalised_sum_ng_gdw

    Numeric. Relative contribution of an individual compound to the corresponding contaminant-family sum, calculated from dry-weight concentrations. Values are proportions and therefore dimensionless despite the historical variable suffix.

    Source

    CHOPIN project benthic macrofauna sampling and contaminant analytical dataset.

    Details

    Contaminant concentrations are provided on a dry-weight basis. PCB and HBCDD concentrations are also provided after lipid normalization. Additional variables contain summed concentrations by contaminant family and the relative contribution of individual compounds to these sums.

    The dataset includes bivalves, polychaetes, and crustaceans sampled in several areas of the Seine estuary during spring and autumn 2017.

    Individual contaminant identifiers follow the nomenclature provided in contam_info. Variables ending in _ng_gdw contain concentrations expressed relative to organism dry weight, whereas variables ending in _ng_glw contain concentrations normalized to lipid weight.

    Lipid-normalized variables are available for PCB congeners and HBCDD isomers. PFAS concentrations are retained on a dry-weight basis.

    Variables containing normalised_sum describe the contribution of each individual compound to the total concentration of its chemical family and should not be interpreted as contaminant concentrations.

    Zero values in contaminant variables are retained as provided in the analytical dataset and should not automatically be interpreted as true absence without considering analytical detection and quantification limits provided in contam_info.
